title: flowlink action
description: Sends a copy of the message to another flow in this dif process, whose source is a flowlink source.

targetFlowId.title: Target flow ID
targetFlowId.description: Id of the flow to send the message to

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: sync (also direct, vm): wait until the target flow has processed the message; async (also seda): do not wait, unless exchangePattern is InOut

exchangePattern.title: Exchange pattern
exchangePattern.description: InOut: the target flow's outcome replaces the message; InOnly: the message passes on unchanged

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the target flow
